# v4.1 Rust tray helper

## Summary

- Fixed intermittent raw-path paste: the PNG is now written to disk **before** the WSL path is pasted, so CLI agents (Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode) reliably render it as an `[Image #n]` attachment instead of leaving a literal `/mnt/...` path (#4)
- Hardened key injection: waits for physical modifier release, adds an Alt menu-mask key, and releases right Alt, reducing "hotkey fires but nothing is pasted" cases (#2)
- New tray option `路径格式` (path style): plain / `@`-prefixed for Kimi Code CLI, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code / quoted for paths with spaces (#5)
- README now ships a FAQ / troubleshooting section covering the three issues above
- `cargo check` / `cargo clippy` now work from non-Windows hosts (resource embedding is skipped off-Windows)

## Assets

- `WSL-Image-Clipboard-Helper-v4.1.zip`
